title: S6: Import cached zero-shot test answers with a hash-equality spec
description:
## Purpose

Make arm 0 free by reusing the cached Jev zero-shot answers.

## Scope

Seed holistic question byte-identical to the static study's (wording, `choice` type, criteria order); import rows from `.data/dev/emotion.scoreboard2.sqlite` (jev-1.13.0) with `AnswerCache.put_hashed`. Pool items still cost requests.

## Specs (first, beside the module)

seed question hash equals the cached rows' hash; import writes under the same keys; re-import is a no-op.

## Reuse

`AnswerCache.put_hashed`.

## Definition of done

Hash-equality spec passes on the real cache (skipped cleanly if the cache is absent); import is idempotent. If hashes differ, record it (arm 0 then costs ~$0.60 more on the final slice).

## Cost

$0 (offline, no network).

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)

comments.text: Done in 9c6dd4b. Soundness verified offline: the static zero-shot request is {state:{labeled_examples:[],target:{text}}, questions:{'emotion': choice body, labels in order}}; all 2,000 recorded state fingerprints reproduce exactly (sha256 of that compact JSON). The harness differed (name 'Emotion', state {text}, no Emotion seed score existed), so Emotion corpus now uses score name 'emotion', a seed score with the study's exact question, and a zero-shot client wrapper sending the study's state shape (planted untouched). Importer unified_import.py wire-checks every item, refuses other model versions, is idempotent and text-free. Real file: 2,000 zero:0 cells, all test ids present, 2,000/2,000 wire matches, 0 mismatches. Request bound left unchanged (conservative; arm 0 was already 0 and A-c/F eval requests are new-question/list requests, not holistic). Pool items still paid live.
